Hi Luca — thanks for the clear summary.

Short answer: yes, we can support a multi-entity payment execution. Proposed approach below (aimed to preserve VAT reclaimability and make your AP reconciliation straightforward):

1) Execution model (recommended): payment waterfall (two invoices):
   - Invoice A (Novamed S.p.A.) — EUR 36,000 (60%) — VAT reverse-charge fields populated; invoice will be issued to Novamed S.p.A. with Italian VAT registration noted.
   - Invoice B (Novamed Ireland Ltd.) — EUR 24,000 (40%) — no VAT (intra-EU supply) / or reverse-charge as applicable; invoice will be issued to Novamed Ireland Ltd.

2) Alternate model (single physical PDF): can include line-level entity tags but many EU treasuries prefer distinct legal-entity invoices for automated processing. If you prefer single PDF with tags, we will need a PO that references per-line payee.

3) Required fields for automated reconciliation: please include in the bank transfer reference: "RDW-INV-9821 | NOVA-IT:36000 | NOVA-IE:24000". Our AR ingestion will parse that and match to the two invoices.

4) GL / cost centers: we will print your provided GL codes as a free-text "Your reference" field and also populate the internal memo so our accounting exports include cost-center mapping (GL:5042 -> line item 1; GL:3011 -> line item 2). Please confirm which GL maps to which portion if the split is different from what you stated.

5) Next steps / attachments: I attached a short remittance template (redwood_split_remit_template.xlsx) with the bank refs we require and an example transfer reference, plus a checklist for VAT docs. If you can send your VAT cert, we will attach it to the customer record and notate the invoices.

Ben / Laura — can you confirm we can issue two invoices that will be automatically reconciled by our AR pipeline when Novamed uses the transfer reference above? If there are any limits on splitting or required memo fields, flag them here.

Luca — once you confirm, I'll kick off billing and ask Laura to queue the two invoices and issue them as separate legal-entity documents.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
